title: CSV Round-Trip
prompt: Implement `serialize(items)` producing lines `name,price,qty` and `parse(csv)` producing the items back. Round-trip must preserve everything.

tests.name: serialize
tests.hint: One line per item, comma-separated, trailing newline.

tests.name: parse
tests.code: auto items = parse(std::string{"pen,2.5,120\n"}); CHECK_EQ(items.size(), 1); CHECK(items[0].name == std::string{"pen"}); CHECK_NEAR(items[0].price, 2.5, 0.001); CHECK_EQ(items[0].qty, 120);

tests.name: roundtrip
tests.code: std::vector<Item> items{{"a", 1.0, 2}, {"b c", 3.5, 4}}; auto again = parse(serialize(items)); CHECK_EQ(again.size(), 2); CHECK(again[1].name == std::string{"b c"});
tests.hint: Two items survive intact — names may contain spaces; commas may not.
